sourceChanges: packages/web/server/lib/host/worker-operation-authorizer.js (+ test, DOCUMENTATION.md): admit only non-isolated native `task` delegation after scope/agent/preset/explicit-deny checks; isolated children are refused because SDK isolation drops the programmatic authorization extensions, and caller-supplied child names must be one safe path segment.
